zoom.outOfRange: Exact value kept outside the slider range.

effects.compensation: Compensation: {value} rad/octave. The twist stays visible, its rotation with the zoom is followed.
effects.axesFollow: The axes follow the Droste phase with the zoom.
effects.shared: Settings shared by the player and the video, remembered for this document.

radial.title: Radial playback

mirror.label: ◉ Fixed mirror
mirror.description: Still ring: the content moves in opposite directions on either side. Depths outside the band are repeated.

repeat.label: ↻ Repeat
repeat.description: Last octave → first. Direct cut, without a fade.

pingpong.label: ↔ Ping-pong
pingpong.description: The whole range back and forth, continuously. The mirror acts inside the image.

radial.label: ◎ Radial kaleidoscope
radial.description: A range repeated in mirror on concentric circles.

folds.label: ⇢ Progressive folds
folds.description: Each range is played forth-back-forth, then the next one.

radial.startAria: Start octave of the radial playback
radial.startSliderAria: Choose the radial start in the band
radial.mirrorHint: Percentage of the image reference radius.
